title: Lunch Time
text:
Here is the menu at the Blue Bowl. There are soup, rice and fish. The fish is fresh and the rice is hot.

John likes fish. His sister likes soup. They drink water. The restaurant is open at noon.

questions.text: Where do John and his sister probably eat?

options: They are thirsty and want a drink with their meal
They want to go to sleep

vocabulary.definition: a list of food and drinks in a restaurant
recently made, grown or caught, not old
a place where people pay to eat a meal

paragraph_translations: Oto menu w restauracji Blue Bowl. Są zupa, ryż i ryba. Ryba jest świeża, a ryż jest gorący.
John lubi rybę. Jego siostra lubi zupę. Piją wodę. Restauracja jest otwarta od południa.
